extraction_notes: Extracted SI performance data from SI Table S1, SI Table S3, and readable SI Figures S1 and S4. SI Table S2 contains only reaction orders and is not a catalyst-performance entry. SI Figures S6–S7 and SI Table S4 are characterization/out of scope. SI Figure S2 reports additional La/Pr-ratio plot data, but two catalysts are not in the supplied catalyst-name list and the Ru/La0.5Pr0.5O1.75_650red point is captured exactly in SI Table S3; therefore no separate SI Figure S2 records were added. SI Figure S3 is a kinetic fit plot; corresponding rates are captured in SI Table S1. For SI Table S1, the SI text states kinetic analyses were performed at 350 °C and 0.1 MPa, while SI Figure S3 caption says 400 °C and 0.1 MPa; records use the SI text value and note the conflict.
